text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san, Journey-san. Thank you so much 
for having me the other day.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Gold Ochazuke Gig"... We had all kinds of 
ochazuke, and it was mighty fine fun.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what kind words. All our 
enthusiastic preparations were worth it, 
right, Or?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "...Lala, is it? What caught your eye?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What you consider the finest piece— answer 
me.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(............Am I being tested? Yeah, has 
to be, right? Orfe-san suddenly invited me 
out, so I was wondering what was up, but—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it, she invited me to test me, 
didn't she!?\nThis is a huge chance to 
earn her respect...!\nI gotta put my all 
into choosing! Uhh, let's see~...!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...It really is difficult, isn't it? 
There were so many exquisite items the 
other day, after all. The item recommended 
by Orfevre was magnificent as well."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please, answer as your heart desires. Just 
follow where your heart... drifts.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"! ...My favorite was the final bowl. It 
was blended with gyokuro... such a deep, 
aromatic flavor."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(............Looks like it worked? All 
right! Journey-san, thank you so, so 
much!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Orfe-san... I'm ready anytime!\nI'll wolf 
down ochazuke or whatever else you serve, 
so please invite me again, okay~!)
